newsitem.title: USA: Argentina's Confluencia Sur field now at 2,520 b.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Confluencia Sur field now at 2,520 b.

text.p: Parker & Parsley Petroleum Co said Wednesday the Confluencia Sur field, located in the Neuquen Basin, Mendoza province of West Central Argentina, is producing 2,520 barrels of oil per day following the completion of three development wells.

Noting production is facility constrained, the company said two or three additional wells are expected to be drilled in the first half of 1997 and production is expected to reach about 6,000 barrels daily as facilities are enhanced.

Parker & Parsley said it has a 14.43 percent interest in the field, which is operated by Petrolera Argentina San Jose SA. Company officials were not immediately available to provide the names of other owners.

The company said the three development wells -- Sierra de Reyes 2,3 and 4 -- collectively tested 3,727 barrels of oil per day. The discovery well, Sierra de Reyes-1 tested 820 barrels of oil per day. Each well is producing from the Troncoso formation between 6,100 feet and 6,700 feet.
